resources.string: Restricted by Install Lock. Open Install Lock > Why apps are locked, or tap its notification, for the active rules and recovery steps.

Install Lock is enforcing a restriction configured on this phone.

Open Install Lock > Why apps are locked, or tap the Install Lock notification, to see the active rules, waiting periods and recovery steps.

An app can have several active locks. A temporary app unlock does not override curfew, cooldowns, required accessibility or VPN protection, or website rules.

Android may describe these Install Lock restrictions as work policy even on a personal phone.
App or setting blocked? Tap to see the reasons.
Android may label Install Lock restrictions as work policy. This page shows the active app locks and recovery steps.
Install Lock browser and Google keyword filter

Checks browser address bars against your ordered domain rules and manga/comics category watchdog. Reads visible browser webpages and Google app content to detect your blocked words. Watches scrolling on recognized YouTube Shorts, Instagram and Reddit feeds in apps and supported browsers. Warnings can lead to a 30-minute browsing, social-app and installation cooldown. Per-word and generic exceptions apply to keyword filtering. A blocked keyword match in Google opens a new-search screen; in browsers, tries to close the tab, otherwise returns Home. Processing stays on this device; inspected content is not stored or sent anywhere.
